description: Test-only dependency manifest. leg-solver.test.mjs needs the real npm `clingo-wasm` package (a WASM build of clingo) to smoke-test the vendored ASP domain against a realistic generated fact set -- the app itself stays build-free and loads clingo-wasm from jsDelivr at runtime (see app/static/js/leg-solver.js). Run `npm install` in this directory once before running the tests with plain `node`.
